caption: The drawing features a single object composed of wrought iron with two prominent spiral or scroll shapes that are mirror images of each other. Both scrolls are joined at their bases by a short, central vertical segment, which forms the axis from which the scrolls extend outward. The left and right scrolls are relatively symmetrical, curling inward in a tight spiral, with the right scroll slightly larger and containing an internal, smaller spiral. The coloring of the object is primarily a dark gray to black, with hints of brownish-rust tones along the edges that suggest a metallic surface with slight oxidation. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional decorative elements. In the lower right corner, the name "Ethel Dougan" is written in small, neat script.
title: Andirons
